payload_json: {"assigned_to":null,"body":"Decision 0006; see docs/decisions/0006-value-and-field-ownership.md and docs/ownership-prototype.md.\nCurrent compiler eagerly copies fixed-size components on repeated uses and moves final uses by CFG liveness. Add automatic borrow/retain/transfer selection and a real immutable shared representation where it is useful. A private callee write must preserve the caller's logical value. No new source-level memory-management choice.\nAcceptance: checked Core represents storage actions; interpreter, JIT, and standalone execution agree on sharing and mutation; retain, release, allocation, and copy-on-write sites have source-attributed cost events; demonstrate when sharing improves over eager copies.","filed_by":"codex:phoebe-project-migration","labels":["ownership-v1"],"metadata":{"kind":"task"},"queue":"phoebe","title":"Infer shared storage and copy-on-write for closed values"}

{"assigned_to":null,"body":"Decision 0006 destination-passing direction; see docs/ownership-prototype.md.\nExtend Core with typed caller-owned destinations and per-field initialization state, starting with a two-field product and then active sum variants. Publish only complete results. Keep destinations stable across suspension. Error, cancellation, and deadlock paths must clean exactly initialized owned fields and rights once.\nAcceptance: verifier rejects missing or duplicate field initialization and premature publication; interpreter, JIT, and standalone tests cover success, early ?, failure, and suspension; cost ledger identifies material allocation and copies.","filed_by":"codex:phoebe-project-migration","labels":["ownership-v1"],"metadata":{"kind":"task"},"queue":"phoebe","title":"Add checked destination initialization and exact failure cleanup"}

{"assigned_to":null,"body":"Decision 0006 field ownership; see docs/decisions/0006-value-and-field-ownership.md.\nA closed sibling can already be read from a resource-bearing record, but moving a right still requires whole-product unpack. Add per-field ownership and empty-slot tracking so a right field can transfer without duplicating, closing, or resurrecting it. Specify whether the partial record may be used or must be reinitialized before whole-record operations.\nAcceptance: CFG joins, loops, return, send, spawn, and failure cleanup preserve exact capability ownership; forged Core double moves are rejected; interpreter, JIT, and standalone agree.","filed_by":"codex:phoebe-project-migration","labels":["ownership-v1"],"metadata":{"kind":"task"},"queue":"phoebe","title":"Support fieldwise capability transfer and partial resource records"}

{"assigned_to":null,"body":"Decision 0006 field-sensitive loans; see docs/ownership-prototype.md.\nRepresent loan roots and nested field paths in checked Core. Use an exact terminating regular-language or automaton overlap test internally, with no regex source syntax. Parent loans conflict with child mutation or transfer; disjoint sibling fields can coexist. Keep cross-task references forbidden.\nAcceptance: verifier and source lowering accept disjoint field loans, reject overlapping parent/child loans and moves, handle CFG joins and calls, and have differential interpreter/native tests plus checker tests that expose any conservatism.","filed_by":"codex:phoebe-project-migration","labels":["ownership-v1"],"metadata":{"kind":"task"},"queue":"phoebe","title":"Integrate field-path loans with exact regular-language overlap checking"}

{"assigned_to":null,"body":"This is the integration gate for Decision 0006 after the shared-storage, destination, fieldwise-right, and field-loan tasks.\nReconcile docs/spec.md, docs/core-ir.md, docs/non-pessimization.md, and docs/version-0.0.1.md with implemented behavior. Exercise success, errors, cancellation, suspension, loops, joins, and capability cleanup across interpreter, JIT, and standalone builds. Run bounded model and cost checks; state proof, test, and unverified boundaries explicitly.\nAcceptance: full workspace gate passes, representative end-to-end programs satisfy the five Decision 0006 invariants, and remaining limitations are explicit.","filed_by":"codex:phoebe-project-migration","labels":["ownership-v1"],"metadata":{"kind":"task"},"queue":"phoebe","title":"Complete Decision 0006 cross-backend ownership acceptance gate"}
